title: Shopping care with TiC rates
summary: Research report: which patient questions the price files can answer, use cases, existing tools, product concepts, and what the crawler would need next.

title: Shop one scan
summary: Concept: pick your plan, a service and your ZIP, enter your deductible, and see nearby in-network sites ranked by what you would pay.

title: Check my bill
summary: Concept: compare the allowed amount on your Explanation of Benefits with the rate your insurer posted, and get a ready-to-send question if they differ.

title: Open enrollment plan picker
summary: Concept: estimate a full year's cost for each plan your employer offers, using your own doctors' rates and the care you expect.
